items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jess Stacey as a piano player he liked in Chicago, but the interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of meeting him.

ctx.x: The piano player that I always liked in Chicago, a white piano player was Jess Stacey. I always thought he was great. I still think he's great. You know. But he must have just got discouraged and fed up with it.
That's it. You know, I mean after all.....
